calibration_anchor.closest_anchor: Incremental product launch / community-vote ranking, not a journalist hook
calibration_anchor.why_not_higher: A Product Hunt #1 with 1,000 upvotes is a community-vote vanity metric, not external news; no data, customer proof, or live hook is supplied
calibration_anchor.why_not_lower: There is a real shipped product and a plausibly-correct beat, so it is not a pure floor non-news item

beat_relevance.rationale: Startups/venture is a coherent beat, but reporters do not cover Product Hunt rankings as news

timeliness.rationale: The only timing is a self-generated launch-day ranking, not an external moment

magnitude.rationale: Seed-stage unknown startup; no users, revenue, or market effect stated beyond upvotes

proof_points.rationale: Upvote count is a popularity signal, not data, named customer, or methodology; data_available is false

narrative_quality.rationale: Generic 'AI agent books meetings for founders' framing with no tension or surprise

source_credibility.rationale: Unknown seed startup with no independent credentials stated

improvement_suggestions: Drop the Product Hunt ranking entirely; it is a community vote, not a journalist hook
Lead with first-party data: how many meetings booked, dollar value raised by founders using it, conversion rates
Tie to a current trend reporters are already covering about AI agents in venture fundraising, with named-customer proof

evidence_used.title: Fundraisly hit #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt with 1,000+ upvotes

evidence_gaps: Any external hook beyond the launch-day ranking
honest_assessment: A Product Hunt #1 ranking and upvotes are a community-vote vanity metric, not news. Reporters do not cover Product Hunt rankings, and there is no data, customer, or hook here. Hold until there is real proof.

next_move.rationale: Hold until there is original data or an external hook; there is no story to pitch yet
